purpose: Present ordered activity entries with type markers, actor/provenance, relative time and optional actions.
behaviorProvider: Native ordered list with shared RelativeTime and EmptyState.

component: Render populated data as an ol with the supplied label and li entries keyed by ID. Forward list props in this branch; the supplied label owns aria-label.
For no items render the shared No activity yet EmptyState rather than an empty ordered list. List props/className/label are not forwarded to that replacement.
Default type to event and select a matching decorative icon; caller icon overrides the visual inside the same aria-hidden marker, so the marker carries no independent accessible information.
host: Supply entries in the intended chronological or reverse-chronological order with stable unique IDs. Timeline preserves input order and does not validate duplicate IDs or sort timestamps.
Supply accessible, authorized action components and meaningful title/description content. Timeline does not execute workflow logic, enforce permissions, paginate, load more or persist event changes.

requirements.statement: Supply entries in the intended chronological or reverse-chronological order with stable unique IDs. Timeline preserves input order and does not validate duplicate IDs or sort timestamps.

Render each timestamp through compact RelativeTime, passing shared now/timeZone. Leave absolute tooltip, invalid timestamp and clock behavior to RelativeTime.
Show AI generated text for ai entries whether or not actor is provided. Other types display the actor only when truthy; provenance is separate from task approval.

Conditionally wrap truthy descriptions and actions in their respective slots without inventing event handling. Numeric zero ReactNodes can appear outside a wrapper through the underlying truthiness expressions.
Supply accessible, authorized action components and meaningful title/description content. Timeline does not execute workflow logic, enforce permissions, paginate, load more or persist event changes.
Consume data-display group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: No selection, filtering, virtualization or asynchronous load/error state.
Without explicit now, each RelativeTime maintains its own live timer; choose deterministic references for historical snapshots.
